storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP Chaturbate Downloader makes it easy to record live streams and download videos from Chaturbate.com to your computer.

How it works: Go to any model's page on Chaturbate. If the model is live, click Start to begin recording the stream. For saved videos, click Download. The extension detects the stream from Chaturbate's CDN infrastructure, shows available quality options, and saves it as a standard MP4 file.

It handles LL-HLS streaming, Mouflon DRM decryption, and multi-CDN probing automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized CHATURBATE subfolder.

Key features:
- Live stream recording — capture ongoing broadcasts in real time
- VOD downloads — save recorded videos from model pages
- Mouflon DRM decryption — handles Chaturbate's segment encryption transparently
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions (up to 1080p/60fps)
- Real-time capture progress with elapsed time and segment count
- Right-click context menu for quick captures
- Dark-themed UI with coral pink accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to Chaturbate.com and open a model's page
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and start capture — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I record a live stream?
faq.answer: Go to any model's page on Chaturbate.com while they're live. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon, select your quality, and click Start. The extension records the stream in real time. Click Stop when you're done — the recording saves as MP4.

faq.question: Can I download saved videos (VOD)?
faq.answer: Yes. Navigate to a model's video page (/{model}/videos/{id}). The extension detects the recorded video and lets you download it directly.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension parses the HLS master manifest and shows all available quality variants — typically from 240p up to 1080p at 60fps. Higher resolutions appear first.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a CHATURBATE subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why does the extension say the model is offline?
faq.answer: The model must be currently broadcasting for live capture to work. If they're offline, the extension will show a status message. For saved videos, navigate to their videos page instead.

faq.question: What about private shows?
faq.answer: The extension only works with public streams. Private, hidden, or paid shows are not accessible.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Stream processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
